```{r}
library(tesseract)
library(pdftools)
library("quanteda.textmodels")
library(factoextra)
library(streamR)
library(tidyverse)
library(quanteda)
library(quanteda.corpora)
library(quanteda.textplots)
library(quanteda.textstats)
```

```{r}
pngkyrgyz = pdftools::pdf_convert("D:\\Нова папка\\pdfs\\74-1.pdf")
pngCIS2011 = pdftools::pdf_convert("D:\\Нова папка\\pdfs\\Stpetersburg.pdf")
pngFTA1994 = pdftools::pdf_convert("D:\\Нова папка\\pdfs\\82-1.pdf")
pngGeorgia = pdftools::pdf_convert("D:\\Нова папка\\pdfs\\121-1.pdf")
pngArmenia = pdftools::pdf_convert("D:\\Нова папка\\pdfs\\171-1.pdf")
```

```{r}
text = ocr(pngCIS2011)
textk = ocr(pngkyrgyz)
textFTA1994 = ocr(pngFTA1994)
textGeorgia = ocr(pngGeorgia)
textArmenia = ocr(pngArmenia)
```

```{r}
vectord = c(CIS2011=text,Kyrgyz=textk,FTA1994=textFTA1994,Georgia=textGeorgia,Armenia=textArmenia)
data = bind_rows(tibble(document = "CIS2011", text = text),
tibble(document ="Kyrgyz", text = textk),
tibble(document = "FTA1994", text = textFTA1994),
tibble(document = "Georgia", text = textGeorgia),
tibble(document = "Armenia", text = textArmenia))
data_combined <- data %>%
  group_by(document) %>%
  summarise(text = paste(text, collapse = "\n"))
Agreement_corpus1 = corpus(data_combined,text_field = "text", docid_field = "document")
Agreement_tokens = tokens(vectord,remove_punct=TRUE,remove_symbols = TRUE, remove_numbers = TRUE)
```
```{r}
tokk =  tokens(textk,remove_punct=TRUE,remove_symbols = TRUE, remove_numbers = TRUE)
docfeat_matk=dfm(tokk)
trimdocfeat = dfm_trim(docfeat_matk,min_docfreq = 3)
topfeatures(docfeat_matk)
toks_stopk = tokens_remove(tokk,c(stopwords::stopwords("english"),"the","of",",","and","‘","contracting","shall","parties","or",".",":","-",";","ofthe",")","party","treaty","commission","experts","customs",",","accordance","dispute","paragraph","provisions","goods","agreement","origin","measures","re-export","country","sides","article","damage","restrictions"))
twdfmk <- dfm(toks_stopk)

```


```{r}
textk = Agreement_corpus1
tok =  tokens(textk,remove_punct=TRUE,remove_symbols = TRUE, remove_numbers = TRUE)
docfeat_mat=dfm(tok)
trimdocfeat = dfm_trim(docfeat_mat,min_docfreq = 3)
topfeatures(docfeat_mat)
toks_stop = tokens_remove(tok,c(stopwords::stopwords("english"),"the","of",",","and","‘","contracting","shall","parties","or",".",":","-",";","ofthe",")","party","treaty","commission","experts","customs",",","accordance","dispute","paragraph","provisions"))
twdfm <- dfm(toks_stop)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
twdfm = twdfm %>% dfm_tfidf()
fviz_nbclust(x=as.matrix(t(twdfm)),FUNcluster = kmeans,method = "wss")
clmod=kmeans(t(twdfm),centers = 4)
quanteda.textplots::textplot_wordcloud(twdfm)
pcamod1 = princomp(t(twdfm))
pcamod = prcomp(twdfm)
fviz_pca_biplot(pcamod)
fviz_pca_biplot(pcamod1)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
twdfmk = twdfmk %>% dfm_tfidf()
fviz_nbclust(x=as.matrix(t(twdfmk)),FUNcluster = kmeans,method = "wss")
clmod=kmeans(t(twdfmk),centers = 8)
quanteda.textplots::textplot_wordcloud(twdfmk)
pcamod1k = princomp(t(twdfmk))
pcamodk = prcomp(twdfmk)
fviz_pca_biplot(pcamodk)
fviz_pca_biplot(pcamod1k)
```
